body: Instant voice cloning by MIT and MyShell. Audio foundation model.
plain_description: **Clone a voice and create speech in multiple languages and accents.** Control emotion, accent, rhythm, pauses, and intonation. OpenVoice V1 and V2 are free for commercial use.
technical_description: OpenVoice is an audio foundation model for instant voice cloning. It can clone a reference voice’s tone color and generate speech across languages and accents, with controls for emotion, accent, rhythm, pauses, and intonation. V2 adds improved audio quality and native support for English, Spanish, French, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
title: OpenVoice
